messages:
Security Ops: @channel Notice: new enforcement plan for long-lived service credentials. In 14 days we'll start revoking any service token or static key with TTL > 24h. Please audit and remediate. :warning:

Nora Li: Does this include credentials that Vault rotates daily?

Security Ops: If Vault rotation ensures effective TTL <24h, you're OK. This targets static or manually rotated credentials and tokens recorded in the token inventory.

Ben Harper: Any rollout help for CI jobs? We have a handful using deploy keys.

Security Ops: Recommend OIDC for CI (github actions or runner). Example:
```
uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v2
with:
  role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-actions
```
If you cannot migrate, open an "ephemeral-exception" ticket in #eng-sre with compensating controls listed.

SRE oncall: Timeline: dry-run audit next Monday, enforcement after the 14-day window. Exceptions reviewed within 48h.

Security Ops: Quick action list: 1) run inventory query for tokens >24h, 2) migrate to OIDC/short-lived tokens, 3) rotate static keys now, 4) file exception tickets if needed. We'll publish a CSV of impacted services and a migration checklist.

deploy-bot: policy-change created: svc-cred-short-ttl (id: pc-2026-07).

Nora Li: Thanks, starting audit now.

Ben Harper: Opening ticket for our legacy runner.
